question_response: Dr. Patel is a solid instructor. The lectures are clear and well organized even if they are not always the most exciting.
The course was fine overall. Nothing stood out as exceptional but nothing was particularly bad either.
I appreciated the structured format of the class. Knowing what to expect each week helped me plan my studying.
The material was presented clearly but I wished there were more opportunities for discussion and student participation.
Dr. Patel is approachable and responds to emails quickly. That made a real difference when I had questions outside of class.
The course content was relevant and up to date. I liked that Dr. Patel incorporated recent research into the lectures.
The assignments felt disconnected from what we covered in lecture. More alignment between the two would improve the course.
Exam questions sometimes came from material that was only briefly mentioned in class. That felt unfair and stressful.
More diverse examples in the datasets used would have been helpful. Most examples came from the same narrow context.
The course could benefit from more group work and collaborative projects. Working alone the entire semester felt isolating.
Some students dominated class discussions and there was no structure for more equitable participation. That needs to change.
The pace was manageable but a bit slow at times. I think we could cover more ground with tighter lecture structure.
